title: Environment
description: An unlockable environment in a world map (world/environments.jsonl, ADR-0018). Packs supply all environment text and content ids; the engine ships none. Unlock state derives entirely from the learner's mastery of pack content.

id.description: Pack-unique environment id. Not a content id: environments are scenes, not learnable items.

display_name.description: UI label for the environment. Describes the activity the place affords; makes no learning-outcome or proficiency claim.

content_id.description: A content id declared by this pack (lexicon entry, sentence, or grammar concept). Checked against the pack's id collection at validation; an unknown id fails the pack (environment_unknown_content).
